 Kendall Jenner was left looking horrified by her parent Caitlyn Jenner ‘s remark on television.
 On the Thursday (October 22) episode of The Kardashians , Kendall and Caitlyn met up for a meal.
 “So since I never get to know, how’s the love life? I never know what’s going on, I’m always the last to know,” Caitlyn asked. It was clear, however, that Kendall did not want to talk about her love life at that moment.
 Caitlyn doubled down with, “Well, that’s the normal thing for a father to ask. You’re okay?”
 Kendall responded, “I am so okay it’s unbelievable.”
 When Scott Disick arrived, they sat down to eat together.
 1 
 It was in this moment that Caitlyn said something that horrified both her daughter and Scott .
 “That is a very good-looking egg sandwich,” Caitlyn said. While taking a bite, egg yolk got on her hand. “Ugh, I took a bite and it [CENSORED] in my mouth.”
 Hulu bleeped out the exact word Caitlyn said, but it caused a visceral reaction in her lunch-mates. 
 Kendall said, “Dad, oh my God…I don’t think I’ve ever heard you say that. I could’ve lived my whole life without hearing you say that.”
 “Sorry! Look! It just squirted over everything,” Caitlyn responded.
 Scott chimed in with, “I love it. Actually, I could’ve not lived my whole life without it, because I used to get in so much trouble for saying those jokes.”
 Last year, Kendall opened up about her relationship with Caitlyn , with their differing views.
